AccessKey.description: An access key, without its secret.

prefix.description: First characters of the secret, to recognise it.

expires_at.description: Mandatory expiry, in the future and one year away at most.

ActionDef.description:
An action declared on a type (D183): invoked from the object page,
executed by the deployed flows holding a matching `action_trigger` node,
journaled. Never executed by the server itself (D123).

confirm.description: The UI asks for an explicit confirmation before invoking.

params.description: Parameters asked at invocation (scalar properties only).

ActionInvocation.description:
Invocation result, returned to the caller and journaled in the object
provenance (`object_changes`, action `action.invoke`).

flows.description: Deployed flows holding a matching trigger at invocation time.

AgentEnrollResponse.description:
Credentials returned once to the enrolling agent. Enrolling rotates the
device token and key: any previous installation is disconnected (4005).

ca_pem.description: Local root CA PEM to pin (`None` = publicly trusted certificate).

client_cert_pem.description:
TLS client certificate + PKCS#8 key (PEM) issued by the org CA
(D153). Every enrollment revokes the previous ones.

device_host.description:
Device endpoint (`host[:port]`, D158) the agent connects to over
wss.

encryption_key.description: Base64 32-byte pre-shared key of the Noise link (D156).

ws_path.description: WebSocket path on the same origin (`/ws/device`).

AgentEnrollmentCreated.description:
`POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/agent-enrollment` → a fresh single-use code
(previous pending codes of the device are revoked).

ca_sha256.description:
Hex SHA-256 of the exact `/api/v1/meta/ca` body (`None` = no local CA:
the server certificate is publicly trusted).

AgentFingerprint.description: What the extension reads by itself at pairing (no user input, D266).

agent_version.description: Agent version from its last announce.

hostname.description: Machine facts reported at the last successful enrollment.

AgentKey.description: One key discovered from an agent (`GET /api/v1/devices/{id}/agent-keys`).

record_o2.description: OpenObserve history on/off (Valkey live cache is always on).

AggregateOp.description: How the values of one bucket are combined.

AggregateRequest.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/telemetry/aggregate/query`; the series selector follows
the `series/query` rules (device and/or free labels, D171).

AggregateResponse.description:
`available: false` = O2 not configured, unreachable or past the budget:
the rows keep their shape, unread values stay `None`.

AggregateRow.description:
One bucket. Ranges: `start`/`end` RFC 3339 of the basis used. Slices:
`start`/`end` are the local `HH:MM` bounds and `days` counts the days
of the window that had data.

value.description: `None` = no data in the bucket (or not read: see `available`).

AggregateWidgetOptions.description:
Options of the `range_bars` widget (per range / per time slice bars).
The series is the widget's single source.

AiConversation.description:
One conversation of the current user in the current org (D145); list
rows never carry messages nor tool traces.

AiMessage.description: One stored message of a conversation.

AiPageContext.description: Page the user is on when asking (current route and opened entity).

AiRetention.description:
`GET /api/v1/ai/retention` — how long inactive assistant conversations
are kept in the current org (D145).

days.description: Effective value (days): the org value, at most the platform one.

editable.description: The caller may change the org value (owner/admin).

org_days.description: Org value (days), when the org shortened it.

platform_editable.description: The caller may change the platform value (platform admin).

AiRetentionDays.description: Effective platform retention (days) after an update.

AiRole.description: Author of a stored assistant message.

AiSendMessage.description:
`POST /api/v1/ai/conversations/{id}/messages` — only the new message:
the history is rebuilt by the server.

configured.description: The org has a default provider (users bring their own LLM).

AiToolTrace.description: Trace of one tool call shown in the chat (collapsible bubble, deep link to the flow).

code.description:
Machine code of a coded refusal (`err_codes`), resolved by the UI
as `err-<code>`; `summary` stays the verbatim fallback.

flow_id.description: Flow the tool touched: drives the "Open in the editor" button.

summary_key.description:
Fluent key of a successful call's summary (`ai-trace-*`), rendered
with `args`; absent on traces stored before it existed.

conversation.description: Updated conversation (title set by the first message).

AnalysisState.description: State of an analysis step (wire form of [`STATE_QUEUED`]…).

AnalysisStep.description: One analysis step of a media version.

AnnotationDoc.description:
Full document of a layer (content of
`annotation_layer_versions.doc`).

AnnotationGeometry.description:
Geometry of an item: on an equirectangular sphere (panorama) or as a
fraction of a flat image container (photo/floorplan).

oneOf.description: Panorama: yaw in [-180, 180], pitch in [-90, 90] (degrees).
Flat image: x/y in [0, 1] (fraction of the `img` container).

Gaussian splat: a point in the scene's world coordinates (any finite
value — the scale is the capture's own).

AnnotationItem.description: Annotation item placed on a media.

media_asset_id.description: `media_assets.id`: the single anchor of the system (D55).

target.description:
Weak target, tagged by `type`: `device {device_id}`, `pin {device_id, pin_gpio}`,
`status {device_id}`, `note {text}`, `control {control_id, kind?}`,
`reading {source, display?, min?, max?}`.

AnnotationLayer.description:
Annotation layer available for a camera over a window
(`GET /api/v1/cameras/{device}/recordings/layers`).

count.description: Annotated frames in the window.

AnnotationLayerDetail.description: Annotation layer detail: the summary plus the document of the requested version.

doc_version_number.description: Version of the returned document (latest, or the one asked with `?version=`).

tour_id.description: Attached tour, exclusive with `media_asset_id` at creation.

AnnotationLayerSummary.description:
Annotation layer in a list (like `TourSummary`); `media_asset_id` is the
media the layer is attached to. `PartialEq` is required by the CRUD
component props (dioxus 0.7 `#[component]`).

tour_id.description: Attached tour, exclusive with `media_asset_id` at creation.

AnnotationLayerVersionDetail.description: One version in detail (audit, editor reload).

AppInput.description: Creating (`expected_version` absent) or replacing an application.

AppScope.description:
What an application reads. The change feed and the object sets keep to
it (D433, Q-A1); the media fields tell its copy what to download.

media_kinds.description: Media kinds to copy (`photo`, `document`…); empty = none.

media_max_bytes.description: Largest media to copy, in bytes.

types.description: Object types (system types included, `media_asset` for media).

service_account_id.description: The service account the application signs in with.

AsrCarrierCheck.description:
Check of a model on one carrier (`worker:<host>` or a name set by the
platform).

AsrModel.description:
Audio model of the registry (D167): a `model` media asset (archive or
GGML file) read by the `pnex-asr` runtime.

carriers.description:
Checks on the dedicated transcription workers (D167), one per
carrier.

check.description: Check on the server (where `ml_models.check_status` comes from).

family.description:
Read from the files (`parakeet_tdt`, `canary`, `whisper`,
`whisper_ggml`, `silero`, `pyannote_segmentation`,
`speaker_embedding`), never typed.

task.description: Read from the files like the family.

AsrModelCheck.description:
Check of an audio model on the server (D167): load + transcription of
the reference sample.

wer.description: Word error rate on the French reference sample.

AsrModelInput.description: Create / update body of an audio model; absent fields keep their value.

diarization_model_id.description:
Diarization = a segmentation model (`diarization_model_id`) and a
speaker embedding model, both set or both absent.

AsrProfileInput.description: Create / update body of a profile; absent fields keep their value.

diarization_embedding_model_id.description: Speaker embedding model of the diarization; empty string clears it.

diarization_model_id.description: Segmentation model of the diarization; empty string clears it.

AsrTask.description: Registry task of an audio model (D167), read from its files.

AsrTestResult.description:
Result of `POST /api/v1/asr/models/{id}/test`: an uploaded clip
transcribed by the model (first [`TEST_CLIP_MAX_SECS`] only).

truncated.description: True when the clip was longer and was cut.

AsrTestWord.description: One timed word of a test transcription.

not_empty.description: A previous extract (by name) is not empty.

page_contains.description: The page text contains this (case and accents ignored).

AssignableRole.description: Managed role an assignment may give (owner stays a membership role).

Assignment.description: A role given to a member or a team, over the whole org (I3).

created_by.description: Who made the assignment (`null` once that account is gone).

role_key.description: Key of the role given, managed or custom.

service_account_id.description: Service account that holds it (its identity is `user_id`).

user_id.description:
Identity that holds it: a member or a service account (exclusive
with `team_id`).

AssignmentCreate.description:
New assignment: one holder (`user_id`, `team_id` or
`service_account_id`) and one role (`managed_role` or `role_id`).

AttributionInput.description:
`POST /api/v1/media/{id}/attributions`: one person on one or several
spans (a whole speaker = one span per turn, D273). Confirmed at once.

AttributionOrigin.description:
How a span of a media got its person (D272): every technique is an
origin, none is privileged.

AttributionStatus.description: A machine proposes, a person confirms (D272).

AudioPiece.description: A segment of a stream whose audio is still kept, on the window clock.

AuthVerdict.description: Verdict of one authentication method of the sender.

Basemap.description:
Basemap the map opens on (`GET /api/v1/geo/basemaps`). A basemap key
is a browser key (like a Google Maps key, restricted by referrer at the
provider): it is already in `style_url`.

BoardClaim.description: A claim as the hypotheses board shows it (cases.md K8).

justification.description: Why it is corroborated below two origins (K7), when written.

BoardPinDto.description: One pin of a board profile, with server-computed mux functions, flags, modes and warnings.

BoardPinKind.description: Board-level pin kind (header role) — silicon capabilities live in caps.

BrowserAgent.description: A browser agent of the org (a device of the `browser_agent` model).

BrowserCheck.description: One check of an endpoint test.

BrowserEndpoint.description:
A CDP browser of the org (site-recipes.md D325). The token is a vault
reference, never its value (R4, R16).

BrowserEndpointInput.description: Create or replace a browser endpoint; `token: None` keeps the current one.

BucketBasis.description: Which time a bucket was computed on.

BuildPhase.description: Phase of a firmware build record (lowercase on the wire).

BuildRecord.description: Firmware build record of the org (`GET /api/v1/build-records`).

failure_code.description:
Why a failed build failed (O4): one of [`BUILD_FAILURE_CODES`],
shown translated; absent while the build runs or succeeded.

failure_detail.description:
Last lines of the failing tool output (compiler errors), the
device credentials masked by the worker.

firmware_bin_s3_key.description: Artifact key in the `ArtifactStore` (absent while running or on failure).

fw_version.description:
Version of the built firmware (record id, stamped in the binary as
`PNEX_FW_VERSION` and announced by the device); absent on records
older than OTA.

BuildStats.description: Aggregate of the org `build_records` (bounded: one per device).

success_rate.description: `succeeded / total` in [0,1]; 0.0 when total is 0 (never NaN).

last_frame_ms.description: Unix ms of the last frame received (process lifetime).

CaptionCue.description: One caption of a post, on the video's clock.

CaptionsUpload.description:
Captions of a post read on the platform (stored as a run of origin
`platform`, D281).

CaptureMode.description: Who asks the device to capture (D76).

CaptureProfileParams.description:
`capture_profile` (D333): one capture of one person's profile page, in
the agent's signed-in session. Asked by a human from the person's page,
created by the server only.

CaptureProofParams.description: `capture_proof` (D308, D310): capture one page as a proof.

page_id.description: Registry page the proof is for.

CaptureState.description: Capture supervisor state of a stream, shown on /media.

CaseAttachInput.description:
Attach an object to an event of the case (`event_id`), or put it among
the undated pieces (no `event_id`). The role defaults by object type.

CaseAttachment.description: An object attached to an event of the case, with its role (K21).

link_id.description: The `involves` link, to change its role or close it.

CaseBoard.description:
Hypotheses with the claims for and against them, plus the member claims
that need attention: no source, or contradicted by another claim. No
score: the human concludes (K8).

CaseCheck.description:
One watch check of a case (D430): its worst latest result over the
subjects and scopes of the case, its rules, when it last ran and changed.

runs_since_change.description: Runs since the result last changed.

CaseChild.description: A sub-case, as its parent's workspace lists it (GS16).

members.description:
Members of the sub-case (its events and what they involve, its
undated pieces).

shared.description: Those members that are members of the parent too.

CaseDetachInput.description:
Detach an object from an event (`event_id`: it stays in the case, undated
if nothing else dates it), or remove it from the case (no `event_id`; for
an event, its pieces stay in the case).

CaseDetected.description:
Outcome of a detection run: proposals new to this case (a rejected one is
never proposed again), and whether the position history was readable.

CaseEvent.description: An event of the case and what it involves.

CaseEventInput.description: New event of a case with its first attachments, in one transaction.

CaseExport.description:
A whole case in one document (K33, schema `pnex.case/1`): its events
with their attachments, its undated pieces, the hypotheses board and the
pieces manifest, as they are now.

persons.description: Members of type `person`: the UI warns before handing it out (K16).

CaseImported.description:
A case re-created from an export (K33), in the same org: its events and
their attachments; attachments and pieces whose object is gone (or lives
in another org) are listed, not re-created.

CaseLayout.description:
Positions of the case graph's nodes, in layout coordinates, as the team
arranged them by hand (K31). Empty = the automatic layout.

CaseOpenInput.description:
Opening a case: from scratch, or from a dated alert (cases-workspace.md
K20): its first event is then the alert, with the flow that raised it
and the flow's neighbours attached as context.

parent_id.description: Opens it as a sub-case of this case (cases-graph-sigma.md GS16).

CasePageInput.description: New page of a case, optionally from a template of an installed pack.

lang.description: Language of the template's text (`fr-FR`…); default English.

CasePlace.description: A located member of a case.

CaseProposal.description:
A detection proposed to the case (K30): retained (it became `event_id`),
rejected (kept, never proposed again) or still proposed.

CasePurgeInput.description: Objects to purge from an archived case (cases.md K16).

CaseRead.description:
A logged read of persons' tracks (K38): who, for what (`tracks`,
`detect`, `snapshot`), which objects (`gone` = purged since), which window.

CaseSignals.description: Raw signals of a case over a window, oldest first.

changes_available.description: False when the change journal (O2) could not be read.

truncated.description: True when a source hit its cap: narrow the window.

CaseSnapshot.description: A frozen state of a case: never modified, fingerprinted.

taken_by.description: Display name of who froze it, if still known.

CaseSnapshotFull.description:
A frozen state with its content: the canonical JSON of a
[`CaseSnapshotContent`], byte for byte what was fingerprinted.

CaseTrack.description:
Track of one case member. Each segment is gap-free; each point is
`[lon, lat, alt|null, dt_ms]` with `dt_ms` relative to `t0_ms`, so the
map keeps its precision in float32 (kepler.gl school).

CaseTracks.description:
Tracks of the case members over a window. `available` = false when the
position history cannot be read (O2 absent or never provisioned).

CaseWorkspace.description:
The case as the workspace shows it (K22): its events, oldest first,
with their attachments, and its undated pieces. Members are derived.

checks.description: Watch checks feeding the case (network-check.md D430).

places.description:
Members with a place on the map: a `geo_point` value, else the centre
of their area, else the POI's coordinates.

zones.description: Areas held by members (`geo_area` values, K29), for the map.

CaseZone.description: An area of a case member.

area.description: The `geo_area` value: a circle or a GeoJSON polygon.

ChangeFeed.description: A page of the change feed (`GET /ontology/changes`).

more.description: More entries are ready now: ask again without waiting.

next.description: Cursor to pass as `since` next time (unchanged when nothing is new).

ChangeView.description:
One change of an object or a link (D184), from the O2 `object_changes`
stream.

finding_id.description: The finding object the rule wrote.

finding_ref.description:
The finding by its natural key, when the rule writes it in the same
run (its id is not known yet): resolved through the run's
`finding_type` / `finding_key` once it exists.

Classification.description:
Closed classification list of a property, a link attribute or a type's
title (iam.md D298).

ClockSource.description:
Where the absolute time of a segment comes from (D160): a statistic must
be able to say where its clock comes from.

ClusterItemDto.description:
Cluster answer item: single POI (`count == 1`, `id` set) or numbered
cluster (centroid + sample label).

color.description: Colour token of the pin's coloured status (`green`, `amber`…).

total.description: Number of POIs in the bbox.

CollectPageParams.description:
`collect_page` (D261): refresh a page, keep its readable text (and the
cleaned HTML) as a versioned document.

CollectValueParams.description: `collect_value` (v1 school): refresh a page, read one value.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element (the "pin", D48).

confirm_stop_flows.description:
set_mode only: true = the user confirmed stopping the deployed flows
that use the pin (409 `pin-flow-conflict` without it).

interval_ms.description: subscribe: report period in ms, 100..=3600000, 0 = unsubscribe.

value.description: write: true/false (or 0/1) for digital_out, duty 0-100 for pwm_out.

flow_impacts.description: Flows stopped by a `set_mode` (absent when none).

sent.description: Always true: the command was pushed to the live session.

CompileDiagnostic.description:
One compiler diagnostic. `in_sketch` = points at the user's `main.cpp`
(projected in the editor gutter); others are listed with their file.

message.description: Verbatim compiler message (runtime diagnostic — not translated).

ComponentState.description: Health state of a platform component.

ControlKind.description:
Kind of a control. Plain enum (no internally tagged enum: the workspace
unifies serde_json `arbitrary_precision`).

ControlListener.description: A deployed flow listening to a control (`control-source`).

ControlOption.description:
One entry of a select / command control (D137). The value written and
sent to the flows stays a number (the whole control pipeline is
numeric); `key` is its symbolic form, emitted as `msg.control.option`.

label.description:
Display label; `None` = the UI translates well-known keys
(`open`, `stop`, `heat`…) and shows the key otherwise.

ControlOrigin.description:
Where a surface-declared control lives, resolved for display (control
list, flow node catalog). `surface_name` is `None` when the surface was
deleted meanwhile.

item_id.description: Widget id (`w-0001`) or annotation item id.

ControlRef.description: Reference from a surface item (dashboard widget, annotation) to a control.

ControlSpec.description:
Definition of a control value domain. Flat struct with optional fields
read through defaulting accessors (an unused field for the kind is
ignored).

confirm.description: Ask for a confirmation before sending (dangerous actuators).

options.description: Options of a select / command control (D137).

ControlValue.description:
Last commanded value. Stored and published wrapped in a
[`ControlEvent`] (under [`control_value_key`], on [`control_channel`]).

by.description: Display name of the user who wrote it.

option.description:
Symbolic form of `v` ([`ControlSpec::symbol_of`]): option key of a
select / command, `#rrggbb` of an RGB colour (D137).

ControlValuesResponse.description: Answer of `GET /api/v1/controls/values`: values by control id (`null` = never written, or unknown in the org).

CrawlDone.description:
End of an agent crawl: the pages it read; a complete walk counts the
missing ones (`gone` after two).

CrawlExecutor.description:
Who walks a site (D307): the server (public pages, no script run) or a
browser agent (pages rendered by JavaScript, the D258 pace).

CrawlSiteParams.description:
`crawl_site` (D307): walk one declared site, list its pages, keep the
relevant ones (and their proofs, D308).

match.description: A page matching any rule is relevant; none = every page is.

max_depth.description: Link depth from the entry points (default and at most 5).

proofs.description: Relevant pages new or changed get a proof by an agent (D308).

url.description: Any address of the site: its origin bounds the walk.

CreateAnnotationLayer.description:
`POST /api/v1/annotation-layers`: the layer declares its media
(`media_asset_id`) or its tour (`tour_id`); every item of the document
must be anchored there.

media_asset_id.description: Attached media (UUID string), the single anchor of the layer.

CreateBuild.description: Body of `POST /api/v1/build-firmware`. Unknown fields are refused.

device_id.description:
Registered device of the org; its model and frozen board drive the
build.

pnex_host.description:
PneX server host (e.g. `dev1.pnex.io`), passed to the firmware in
base64. An imposed production host (`PNEX_PROD_HOST`) wins.

wifi_credential_id.description:
WiFi entry of the org's referential (secrets.md S6): the build
references its vault secret, the password never travels.

build_id.description: Id of the new `build_records` row (also the firmware version).

CreateDevice.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/devices`.

When an inactive device already carries this `device_id` in the org, it
is reactivated (200 + `{"reactivated": true}`) instead of created.

board_id.description:
Board variant frozen at registration (`mcu_boards.id`); absent = the
model's default board. Must exist and carry the same SoC as the
model's default board.

firmware_project_id.description:
Custom firmware chosen at provisioning (custom-firmware.md D94) —
must belong to the org and target the board's chip. Absent = the
generic preset firmware.

lang.description: Language of the template's text (`fr-FR`…); default English.

markdown.description:
Markdown the page starts with (titles, lists, tables, code), as the
editor's import does; exclusive with `template`. Up to 256 KiB.

template.description: Key of a page template of an installed pack (O43); absent = blank.

CreateFirmwareProject.description: Creation: project + revision 1 (`main_cpp` absent = starter sketch).

CreateFlow.description:
Creation: the flow and its version 1 in one transaction. `Serialize`
serves the frontend (the editor builds the typed request).

CreateFunction.description: Creation: the function and its version 1, in one transaction.

inputs.description: Declared inputs (one input anchor each); none = one plain input.

outputs.description: Declared outputs (one port each); none = message mode (D497).

asset_id.description: Media asset (kind `model`) holding the ONNX file.
Media asset the panorama is published to (as a new version).

frames_total.description: Number of frames that will be uploaded (2 to 64).

hfov_deg.description: Horizontal field of view of the frames, degrees (1 to 179).

poses.description: One pose per frame, in upload order.

CreatedKey.description: A key just created: the only answer that ever carries the secret.

secret.description:
`pnex_sk_…`: shown once, keep it on the server side of the
application (environment variable, secret store).

CustomCommandRequest.description: Custom command sent to a device (D88) — `POST /devices/{id}/custom-commands`.

cmd_id.description: Command id; the device answers with `Ack{cmd_id}`.

CustomRole.description: A custom role of the org.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency: send it back as `expected_version`.

DashboardFormat.description: Dashboard format, chosen at creation and never changed (D123).

DashboardLayout.description:
Layout of a dashboard, stored as JSONB in `dashboard_versions`.
Telemetry points are never stored (D31).

object_type.description:
Type dashboard (ontology D187): drawn for any object of this type,
picked by the viewer; sources may then read `object_property`.

pages.description:
Mobile only: pages (tabs) of the dashboard, empty = one implicit
page (D139).

sections.description:
Mobile only: widget order and grouping (every widget in exactly one
section).

DeliveryStatus.description: Outcome of a delivery attempt, as read back from the journal.

force.description: Allow redeploying the version the device already runs.

version.description:
Target build version (record id string) — None = latest deployable
build (successful + OTA-stamped).

DeployFlow.description:
Explicit deployment of a version (projection + runtime reload).
Absent `version_number` = latest version.

DetectQuery.description: Detection request (K30): RFC 3339 bounds, defaulting like signals.

DetectionResult.description: Result of one inference (test endpoint, flow node).

Device.description:
Registered device: `GET /api/v1/devices` and detail (same shape in list
and detail).

connected.description:
Live websocket session. False = currently disconnected (or never
connected); the UI greys out OTA deployment.

device_id.description: Identifier declared by the firmware (MAC, hostname…).

discovered_measurements.description:
Discovered measurement names (only when dynamic measurements are
allowed).

firmware_project_id.description:
Custom firmware project the device runs (custom-firmware.md D94) —
`None` = generic preset firmware.

fw_version.description:
Firmware version announced by the device ("who runs where",
edge-model.md §9) — None until the first announce of a stamped build.

last_seen.description:
Last data received (liveness lease), RFC 3339; absent when the
device never ingested.

latest_build.description:
Latest firmware build status (`null` when never built),
server-side enrichment.

ota.description:
Active (non-terminal) OTA deployment, if any — list + detail
enrichment; progress updates as the device reports OtaState frames.

ota_ready.description: OTA admission: the announced caps manifest contains the `ota` cap.

rebuild_required.description: False when the device already ran on that board.

DeviceCount.description: Device count aggregated over the orgs of the user.

device_id.description: Business `device_id` declared by the firmware (the numeric PK is `id`).

DevicePeripheralsUpdated.description:
Answer of `PUT /api/v1/devices/{id}/peripherals`; takes effect at the
next build.

DevicePlacementDto.description: D43: placement of a device on a POI (one placement per device).

DeviceReactivated.description:
Answer of `POST /api/v1/devices` when a known inactive device is
reactivated (200 instead of 201).

DeviceTokenInfo.description:
Device token, returned to writers for provisioning (the device encrypts
with `encryption_key`).

DiffClose.description: An object archived or a link closed by a snapshot run.

DiffEnd.description:
An end of a link: an existing object, or one created by the run
(index in `created`).

propose.description: Written as a proposal, not as a link (D375).

version.description: Object version read by the preview: the application writes on it.

DocComment.description:
One comment (P12). A thread root has `parent_id = None` and carries the
anchor; replies point to their root.

anchor.description: Opaque anchor written by the editor (Yjs relative positions).

author.description: Display name of the author, if still known.

mine.description: The caller wrote it (may edit and delete it).

version_number.description: Named version current when the comment was posted.

DocVersionState.description:
`GET /api/v1/docs/{id}/versions/{n}`: frozen Yjs state (v1 encoding,
base64), opened read-only by the editor for viewing, diff and restore.

approved_by.description: Display name of who approved it, once approved.

created_by.description: Display name of the author, if still known.

ErrorDetail.description:
Error body of every non-2xx answer: machine `error` code (frontend key
`err-<code>`), canonical English `description`, optional `errors`:
`args` (interpolation strings), `fields` (`field-invalid`: field →
machine token) or `violations` (`*-invalid` documents). Mirrors
`loco_rs::controller::ErrorDetail`.

payload.description: Parsed back from the stored JSON string.

EvidenceItem.description:
A piece proving an object (external-apps.md D437): a media reached
through evidence link types, with its current file and, for a web
proof part, the proof's seal.

via.description: Link types followed from the object, in order.

ExpandFacet.description: Neighbours of one link type and one object type.

ExpandInput.description:
Expansion of a node of the case graph (K31). Without `pick`: the
neighbours counted by link type and object type; with it: those
neighbours and their links. `exclude` = nodes already shown.

expires_in.description: Lifetime of the ticket in seconds.

between.description: Page text between the first marker and the next second one.

selector.description: Text of every element matching this CSS selector.

FeedAction.description:
What happened to it: `close` = archived object or closed link, `delete`
= row removed (its state is gone).

FeedEntry.description:
One entry of the change feed: the latest change of an object or a link
within the page, with its current state (none after a delete).

cursor.description: Position of this entry: resume after it with `since`.

FeedHead.description: The newest position of the change feed (`GET /ontology/changes/head`).

FeedKind.description: What a feed entry is about (external-apps.md D435).

FieldSpec.description: Field of a channel configuration form, rendered by the frontend.

options.description:
Choices of a `select` field (a select without options renders as
text).

FieldType.description: Type of a channel form field ([`FieldSpec`]).

FirmwareCheckState.description: State of a compile-only check (lowercase on the wire).

FirmwareProjectDetail.description: Project + current revision (the editor loads this).

chip_family.description: Wire id of the target chip family (`esp32`, `esp8266`…).

FirmwareRevisionSummary.description: History entry — full content so any past revision can be restored.

FloorPlan.description:
Imported floor plan: reference to a `media_asset` of kind `floorplan`.
Asset ids are `media_assets.id` UUIDs as strings (the crate stays
without the uuid dependency, wasm32-safe; existence and kind are checked
by the backend service).

scale_m_per_px.description: Meters per pixel (optional, entered in the editor).

width.description:
Native plan size in px (set by the editor when picked; absent on
native → display fallback).

Flow.description: A flow with the graph of its latest saved version.

unreadable_nodes.description:
Stored nodes left out of `graph` because they no longer read
(`flow-node-retired`, `flow-node-unreadable`); saving drops them.

FlowDebugEntry.description:
One entry of the debug panel (in-memory ring of the supervisor, fed by
the runtime stdout `debug` events attributed to a flow).

msg.description:
Captured value, raw: an object for `pnex-display`, a pre-stringified
string for the builtin `debug` (the client tries to re-parse it).

name.description: Node name, when it has one.

node_id.description: Editor id of the emitting node (`"n2"`, never the engine hash).

FlowDebugFeed.description: Answer of `GET /flows/{id}/debug`: the panel feed, oldest first.

skipped_tabs.description: Tabs of other flows isolated from the artifact.

stale_notify_nodes.description:
Notify references of this flow that are stale (channel missing or
disabled, template missing or changed).

FlowDeployResult.description: `POST /flows/{id}/deploy` answer: the flow plus non-blocking warnings.

FlowEngineStatus.description: Engine health of one flow, as last announced by the runtime.

FlowGraph.description: Graph of a flow, as stored (JSONB) in `flow_versions`.

nodes.description:
Nodes: `{id, name?, position?, outputs?, inputs?, kind, config?}`,
`kind` + `config` per node type (see the flow node docs).

FlowImpact.description: A deployed flow stopped by a mode change.

FlowRuntimeStatus.description:
Flow runtime status seen by the backend supervisor: process health
(`runtime.json`) crossed with the health of THIS flow (runtime events
`flow_started`/`flow_error`/`flow_stopped`). `deployed_flow_id` and
`deployed_version_number` are filled by the handler for the requested
flow, from the database.

debug_tools.description:
Debug tools enabled (`settings.flow.debug_tools`, dev/debug mode
only; in run mode the debug panel answers 403 and is hidden).

engine_status.description:
Engine state of this flow; `null` = unknown (the runtime has not
announced it yet since the backend started).

flow_status.description:
DB status of this flow: an open editor refreshes its runtime
controls when another user changed it.

last_error.description:
Last real engine error of this flow (from the runtime `flow_error`
event), cleared by its next `flow_started`.

latest_version_number.description:
Latest saved version of this flow (DB). Lets an open editor notice a
version saved by another user without reloading the detail.

FlowStatus.description:
Lifecycle status of a flow: `draft` (never deployed), `deployed`
(running), `stopped` (stopped on purpose, deployed version kept for a
restart). Stored as text (`flows.status`), see [`FLOW_STATUS_DRAFT`]…

FlowSummary.description:
Flow summary (paginated list, without the graph).
`PartialEq` is required by the CRUD component props (dioxus 0.7
`#[component]` derives a per-field impl).

unreadable_nodes.description:
Stored nodes left out of `graph` because they no longer read
(`flow-node-retired`, `flow-node-unreadable`); saving drops them.

FlowVersionSummary.description: Version summary (paginated history, without the graph).

FlowViolation.description: Graph validation violation (refused with a 400 by the API).

args.description:
Interpolation data (JSON object of strings: `device`, `pin`…)
consumed by the client-side `err-<kebab>` resolution. Absent until
the construction site is migrated.

message.description:
Canonical English message, display fallback when the code is not
registered in `err_codes::ALL` or the translation fails.

node_id.description: Offending node, when the violation is located.

FluidMixture.description:
API answer for a mixture: identity + stored composition (with the
converted `mole_fractions`) + ready-to-use inline CoolProp spec
(`"Propane[0.5]&Ethane[0.5]"`), `None` when the composition is not
converted yet.

FluidMixtureComposition.description: Composition of a mixture, as stored in JSONB.

molar_mass.description: Molar mass of the mixture (kg/mol), computed on save.

mole_fractions.description:
Mole fractions (same order as `components`), converted on save;
equal to the entered fractions when `basis` is `mole`.

FollowAccountParams.description: `follow_account` (D256): the new posts of one public account.

force_video.description:
Download or record every video (D284). Off: metadata, text and the
platform's captions when it has some, no file.

publisher_id.description:
Ontology object (person or organization) behind the account: each
captured media is linked to it by `published_by` (D278, D281).

FrameAnnotation.description: Detections of one analysed frame, drawn over the recording at playback.

layer_id.description: Layer (detection node) the boxes come from.

ts_ms.description: Unix ms of the analysed frame (camera timestamp).

width.description: Frame size the boxes refer to.

FrameAnnotations.description:
Detection boxes of a camera over a window
(`GET /api/v1/cameras/{device}/recordings/annotations`), sorted by
`ts_ms`, at most [`ANNOTATIONS_MAX`].

FrameSize.description: OV2640 resolutions exposed to users (subset of `framesize_t`).

asset_id.description: Media asset whose confirmed passages of the person are enrolled.

FunctionDetail.description: A function with its current version (code and interface).

FunctionDiagnostic.description:
Editor diagnostic: 1-based line/column, best effort (`null` when the
engine does not expose them). The message is the engine's, verbatim.

FunctionInput.description: Declared input: one input anchor of the flow node.

default.description: Default value when the binding path is absent from the incoming msg.

FunctionLanguage.description:
Language of a registry function: `"js"` or `"starlark"` (stored as
text).

FunctionOutput.description: Declared output: one output port of the flow node.

FunctionSummary.description:
Function summary (paginated list, without the code).
`PartialEq` is required by the CRUD component props (dioxus 0.7
`#[component]` derives a per-field impl).

FunctionTestAdHoc.description: Ad-hoc test of unsaved code (test before saving).

FunctionTestRequest.description:
Live test request: a pinned version of the function (default: the
current version) OR ad-hoc code. `inputs` = typed form values; `msg` =
simulated incoming Node-RED message (default `{}`).

FunctionTestResponse.description:
Live test answer (also the single output line of the
`pnex-flow-runtime --test-function` CLI).

outputs.description: Outgoing messages (one per port that produced a message, in order).

FunctionType.description:
Declared type of an input/output; drives the typed test form (number
field, checkbox...) and the documentation.

FunctionValidateRequest.description:
Compile-only validation request (editor error bar) of
`POST /api/v1/functions/validate`, passed as is to the
`pnex-flow-runtime --check-function` CLI. The code is never executed.

FunctionValidateResponse.description:
Compile-only validation answer (also the single output line of the
`pnex-flow-runtime --check-function` CLI).

FunctionVersionSummary.description:
One version of a function (history drawer, and the version picker of
the flow inspector, which takes the interface snapshot from here).

code.description:
Full code of this version — the history drawer restores ANY past
version into the editor (append-only: saving then creates v+1).

GeoCapability.description: What a provider can do (L16). One default provider per capability.

GeoProvider.description:
Read model of a provider (`GET /api/v1/geo/providers`). The secret is a
vault reference, never a value (R4, R16).

api_key.description: Vault reference of the API key, if any.

default_for.description: Capabilities this provider is the org default for.

key_param.description: Query parameter the key is sent in (`key`, `access_token`, …).

api_key.description: API key; `None` keeps the current one on update.

default_for.description: Capabilities to make this provider the org default for.

GeoProviderKind.description:
Native adapter (L17). Phase F ships Nominatim / Photon (geocoding) and
Valhalla / GraphHopper (routing).
Every adapter authenticates with one optional API key sent as a query
parameter, the way map providers do.

GeoTestResult.description: Answer of a successful provider test.

GeocodeHits.description: Hits of a geocoding call (computed result, not a stored collection).

bbox.description: `[west, south, east, north]` when the provider gives one.

confidence.description: 0..=1 when the provider ranks its hits.

HealthReady.description:
Response of `/health/ready`: the database is critical (`degraded` when it
fails), the telemetry backend (`cache`) is not.

HealthState.description: State reported by the health probes.

Hierarchy.description:
A tree read on links (D305): at each node, its children are the objects
reached by each step in turn. A node with several parents appears under
each of them.

coverage.description:
What makes a node of the tree covered; the others are its white
space (D330).

sums.description:
Number properties summed over the tree's nodes, each node once
(account-mapping.md D330: current and potential users).

HierarchyCoverage.description:
A node is covered when it has an open link of one of `links` (a contact
works there) or one of the `values` of a property (a client site).

HierarchyNode.description: A node of a computed hierarchy, flat in depth-first order.

also_under.description: Titles of the other parents this node also appears under.

link.description: Link type that leads here from the parent (empty for the root).

white_space.description: Not covered, when the hierarchy declares a coverage (D330).

inverse.description: Follow the link from its target to its source.

HierarchyView.description:
`GET /ontology/objects/{id}/hierarchy`: the hierarchies of the installed
packs, and the tree of the one asked (the first by default).

counts.description: Coverage of the tree, computed at read time, never stored (D330).

has_coverage.description: Distinct nodes not covered (`white_space` on each of them).

key.description: Key of the hierarchy computed; empty when none is installed.

truncated.description: The depth or node cap cut the tree.

snippet.description: Excerpt with matches between `⟦` and `⟧` (never found in prose, unlike French quotes).

controls.description: Control bound to each active role (written by the server at save).

on_above.description:
The state source reports "on" when its value is ≥ this threshold
(default 0.5: 0 / 1 sensors).

specs.description: Domain declared per role. An optional role is active iff present.

Hop.description: One traversal step: follow `link_type` links from the current set.

Hunk.description:
One change: paragraphs `from` (index in the old text) and `to` (index
in the new one), with their text.

ImportApply.description: `POST …/apply`: the preview run, on the import version it was read on.

ImportDiff.description: What a run writes (D301): computed by the preview, applied as is.

ImportMode.description:
`incremental`: creates and updates. `snapshot`: also closes what this
import wrote before and the run no longer holds.

ImportPreview.description:
`POST …/dry-run` answer: the run to apply and its difference (each
list cut to 500 entries; `run.counts` has the totals).

steps.description: The run's steps, in order (an import with `steps:`).

ImportRunView.description: One run: a preview waiting for its application, or a finished run.

import_version.description: Import version the run was computed on.

state_args.description:
Its arguments (`{rows, max}` for a source too large, the missing
columns…), for the `err-<code>` message.

state_code.description: Machine code of a refusal or failure (`import-schema-changed`…).

ImportSource.description: Where an import reads its records.

IngestStepView.description: One journaled step of an import run (its run history).

code.description: Machine code of an error (`err-<code>` in the UI).

manifest.description: What the step received and produced (64 KB at most).

run_id.description: One id per pass of the chain.

step.description:
`source_resolve`, `file_download`, `archive_extract`, `table_inspect`
or `rows_filter` (`ontology_import` and `staging_cleanup` in the
journal of retired flow nodes, D359).

params.description: Action parameters by key, validated against the action's `params`.

expected_version.description: Version the editor read (409 when it changed meanwhile).

LabBox.description:
One box: class index + `[x, y, w, h]` normalized to the image (0–1,
top-left origin), so it does not depend on a display size.

frame_ms.description:
Position in its source, ms (epoch for a camera recording, from the
start of the file for a video): orders the frames of a source for
box interpolation. `None` for a still image.

luma.description:
Mean luma 0–255 measured at import (diversity guidance); `None` for
pictures added before it was measured.

proposals.description: What the model proposed on a review picture (normalized boxes).

review.description:
Sent by a detection node because the model hesitated; cleared once
the picture is annotated (active learning, M4).

source.description: Import batch or video the image comes from: the split unit.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency counter of the annotations.

LabImagesAdded.description:
Images added to a project by one gesture (media pick, recording or
video import).

classes.description: Class names; a box refers to its class by index.

LabProjectInput.description: Create / update body of a project.

LabRecordingImport.description:
`POST /api/v1/lab/projects/{id}/import-recording` — frames of a camera
recording (D79) added as pictures, one import = one source (D202).

LabSplit.description: Train / validation assignment of an image.

LabStats.description:
Counts of a dataset and the warnings shown before a training (§4.6.2,
indicative floors: never blocking).

boxes_per_class.description: Boxes per class, in class order.

images_per_class.description: Annotated images showing each class, in class order.

warnings.description: Machine codes (`lab-warn-…`) with their class when relevant.

LabSuggestRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/lab/images/{id}/suggest` — pre-annotation with a model
of the registry (§4.6.1 step 4): proposals only, nothing is written.

class.description: Project class whose name matches the label, if any.

label.description: Label of the model; empty for an interpolated box.

LabSuggestions.description:
Box proposals for one image (pre-annotation, interpolation or
propagation); nothing is written.

LabTrainRequest.description:
`POST /api/v1/lab/versions/{id}/train` — fine-tunes the head of a
registered YOLOX model on a frozen dataset version.

base_model_id.description: `ml_models.id` of the base detector (YOLOX, fixed input).

error.description: Failure code (`err-<code>` in the UI) and its runtime detail.

map50.description: mAP@0.5 on the validation pictures, once evaluated.

LabVideoImport.description:
`POST /api/v1/lab/projects/{id}/import-video` — frames of a video of
the media library (MP4 / MOV) added as pictures, one import = one source.

asset_id.description: Media asset holding the video (its current version is read).

from_secs.description: Extract bounds, seconds from the start of the file.

LabelCatalogEntry.description: One label name of the org with its known values (picker suggestions).

count.description: Resources carrying this name.

LabelsBatch.description: Own labels of each requested id (ids without labels are absent).

labels.description: Own labels: name -> value (`null` = bare tag).

LanScanHit.description: A PNeX server found by the server-side LAN scan (identity checked through the meta probe).

contract.description: API contract of the detected server (informative).

host.description: Bare host without scheme, ready for [`PnexHost::host`].

LanScanResult.description: LAN scan answer: the probed `a.b.c.` prefixes and the servers found, sorted by host.

LatestBuild.description:
Latest firmware build of the device, hydrated into the DTO for the UI
(Firmware column).

deployable_version.description:
Version of the newest SUCCESSFUL, OTA-deployable build of the device
(the OTA target by default). May differ from `fw_version` above when
the newest build is queued/running/failed. `None` = no deployable
build.

failure_code.description: Failure reason of a failed build (O4, see `BuildRecord`).

failure_detail.description: Compiler output tail of a failed build, credentials masked.

fw_version.description: Stamped build version (record id); absent on pre-OTA records.

sources_stale.description:
Staleness tripwire (migration 000031): `Some(true)` = the firmware
tree embedded in the CURRENT server binary differs from the one this
build compiled — the artifact predates the running code, rebuild
recommended. `None` = legacy record (pre-fingerprint), unknown.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339; `null` when the sample carried none.

LibCatalogItem.description: API view of a catalog entry.

chip_families.description: Compatible chip families (wire ids) — empty = all.

LinkClose.description: Closing a link: `valid_to` RFC 3339, default now.

target_dead.description: The target no longer exists (deleted outside the cascade).

target_label.description: Resolved target name; `None` when the target is dead or resolution failed.

valid_from.description: RFC 3339; default now. A link may start in the past (history entry).

valid_to.description:
RFC 3339, after `valid_from` and not in the future: the link is
written closed, as history, even while the same pair has an open
link (only open links are unique per pair).

LinkTypeDef.description: A link type (D179): directed, from a set of types to a set of types.

attributes.description: Attributes carried by each link (scalar properties only).

evidence.description:
The link points at what proves its source (external-apps.md
D437): followed by `GET /objects/{id}/evidence`, and given the
pieces of a web proof sealed on its target.

from_types.description: Source types: `"*"` or a list of type keys.

inverse_name.description: Name read from the target side (« is measured by »).

one_source.description: A target has at most one open link of this type.

one_target.description: A source has at most one open link of this type.

to_types.description: Target types: `"*"` or a list of type keys.

LinkUpdate.description: Updating a link: its attributes, replaced whole (open or closed link).

LiveCameraState.description: Camera state reported by the live test (D104).

LivePartStored.description: Answer of a live part upload.

LiveTestResult.description:
One live-test round (D104): the analysed frame, every detection above
[`DETECT_FLOOR`], the threshold the model applies and machine warnings.

frame_age_ms.description: Age of the frame when analysed, ms.

LivenessSummary.description:
Devices of the org with their live state (join of
`device_registries` and `device_states`).

by_type.description: Device count per device type over the whole org (not capped).

devices.description:
Live devices first, then by `last_seen` descending; capped at ~10
by the backend.

live.description: Devices whose `last_seen_at` is fresher than the silence TTL.

total.description: Full org counts: the list is truncated, the counters are not.

LlmProvider.description:
LLM provider of an org (secrets.md D116, D119):
`GET /api/v1/ai/providers`. The API key is a vault reference, never a
value.

usages.description: Usages this provider serves instead of the default (D212).

LlmProviderInput.description:
Create / update body of a provider. `api_key: None` keeps the current
key on update.

usages.description: Usages to route to this provider; taken away from any other one.

code.description: Machine code of the failure (`err_codes`), rendered as `err-<code>`.

error.description: Canonical English description of the failure (verbatim fallback).

LlmUsage.description:
What an LLM call is for (D212): each usage may run on its own provider,
so the assistant and the flows never have to share one.

LocationNode.description: One step of a location breadcrumb: a site (`map_pin`) or a folder.

LockedHost.description: Server host imposed by the deployment (`PNEX_PROD_HOST`); `host: null` = free choice from the org referential.

media_id.description: The media it was saved as by a reader of the mailbox (mail.md M5).

MailAuth.description:
What PneX verified of the sender (D458): DKIM aligned on the From
domain; SPF stays `none` (a mailbox never knows the connecting IP).

MailForward.description:
The original of a forwarded message (D463): its sender, date and
subject, read from the attached message or from the forward block of the
text. Filed under the original sender only when `trusted`: the mailbox
that forwarded it is a member's address and passed authentication.

MailInvitation.description:
The first event of the `text/calendar` part of a mail (D466): what a
reader adds to the calendar. Times are RFC 3339 in UTC.

uid.description: iCalendar `UID`: an update or a cancellation names the same one.

MailMessage.description: One stored message (D455). Text only: never HTML (D458).

automatic.description: An automatic reply, a list, a bounce (D457.1).

forwarded.description: A forward by a member: file it under `forwarded.from` (D463).

from_pnex.description: Sent by PneX or by a mailbox of the org (D457.2).

truncated.description:
The text was cut at [`TEXT_MAX`], or the message was too large and
only its headers were kept.

Mailbox.description: A mailbox as read: never its password, only whether one is stored.

has_password.description: A password is stored in the vault.

MailboxError.description: Why the poller stopped, as a machine code and its arguments.

MailboxInput.description:
Create or replace a mailbox. `owner_user_id` absent = the caller's own
mailbox; `shared: true` = no owner, read by `teams`.

owner_user_id.description: Another owner than the caller (a service account): admins only.

password.description: A vault secret or a typed value; absent on update keeps the current.

MailboxOwner.description:
Who owns a mailbox (D454): a member or a service account (an agent, an
application); `None` on the mailbox = shared with its teams.

service.description: A service account (agent, application), not a person.

MailboxTestResult.description: Result of `POST /mailboxes/{id}/test`: nothing is fetched nor stored.

junk_folder.description:
The server's spam folder when the mailbox does not poll it: a mail
of a customer filed as spam would never reach PneX.

MarkCount.description: How many distinct nodes of the tree hold a coloured value.

labels.description: Label of the value by language (D370), empty = the value itself.

MatchKind.description: How a relevance rule reads the page text (closed list, D307).

MediaAnalysesState.description: Analysis offers, step states and index state of an asset's current version.

MediaAnalysis.description: Visible state of one step of the current version.

MediaAnnotations.description:
Read model of `GET /api/v1/media/{id}/annotations`: items merged from
the published layers anchored on the media (D55).

MediaAssetDto.description: A media asset (versions summarised: count, total size, current one).

content_type.description: Content type of the current version (data URI on the native frontend).

MediaCaptureDevice.description: A capture box of the org (stream form picker).

MediaChunks.description: A chunk and its neighbours, in document order.

MediaDetections.description:
Objects detected on a video of the library (D215), for the review
screen: the boxes of the latest detection, `ts_ms` = position in the
media (ms), in media order.

model.description: Name of the detection model; `None` before any detection.

unavailable.description: The detection store (O2) is not reachable.

MediaIndexState.description: Index state of the current version (`null` when never indexed).

MediaKind.description: Kind of a media asset (closed set, stored as its wire string).

MediaRun.description: One transcription run of a media asset.

version_id.description: Version transcribed (`pnex` runs); `None` for platform subtitles.

MediaSegmentsRequeued.description: Number of failed segments re-queued for transcription.

MediaSpan.description: A span on the media clock, ms.

MediaStream.description:
Read DTO of a stream. Never carries the secret value (R4, R16): only
whether one is set.

auth_secret.description: Reference to the vault secret (name, never the value).

capture_device.description:
Name (`device_id`) of the capture box when `capture_on` is
`device:<id>` (lot 6b).

capture_error.description: Short machine code of the last capture failure.

fps.description: Video frames per second (D175), used when `tracks` has video.

tdm_checked_at.description:
Date of the text-and-data-mining opt-out check (D172); `None` =
persistent warning.

MediaStreamInput.description:
Create / update body of a stream. On update every field is optional
and absent fields keep their value.

auth_secret.description: Vault secret sent to the URL's origin only (D159, R9).

tdm_checked.description: `true` stamps the TDM check now, `false` clears it.

MediaStreamKind.description:
Transport of a stream. Lot 1 captures the HTTP family; the other kinds
of D159 (DASH, RTSP, DVB) join with their fetcher.

MediaTracks.description:
Tracks captured from a stream (D175): audio goes to the ASR path,
video frames to the camera bus.

MediaTranscript.description:
Transcript of a media for the review screen (`GET
/api/v1/media/{id}/transcript`): the runs, the one shown, its segments in
media order.

attributions.description: Spans attributed to persons (D272), every status, in media order.

unavailable.description: The text store (O2) is not reachable: runs are listed, no text.

MediaVersionDto.description: One version of a media asset.

MemoryKeyInfo.description: One live key of the org (`GET /api/v1/memory/keys`).

MemoryRef.description:
Reference to a numeric memory value, for dashboards: `key` + optional
`field` of an object value (empty = the value itself).

MemoryValue.description: One resolved reference, same order as the request.

MemoryValuesResponse.description:
`POST /api/v1/memory/values/query` answer (an unreachable memory store
is a 503 `memory-unavailable`).

MetadataRecord.description:
One in-band metadata event as stored in `mx_<slug>` (D170) and
returned by `GET /api/v1/media/metadata`.

MetricUnit.description: Unit of a status metric; the UI formats the value by it.

agent_id.description: Pinned agent (device registry id); none = any online agent.

target.description: Normalized target, key of the lease (D257).

MissionPatch.description: Partial update of a mission, on the version the caller read.

MissionSpec.description: A typed mission (D256). `watch_live` arrives with its lot.

oneOf.description: Created by the server only (D308): one proof of one page.

params.description: Created by the server only (D308): one proof of one page.

oneOf.description: Created by the server only (D333): one capture of one profile.

params.description: Created by the server only (D333): one capture of one profile.

MissionState.description: Run state of a mission, reported by its agent.

MixtureBasis.description:
Basis of the entered fractions. CoolProp computes in mole fractions; a
mass entry is converted on save with the CoolProp molar masses.

MixtureComponent.description:
One component of the mixture: a pure CoolProp fluid name + its fraction
in the mixture basis.

asset_id.description: Media asset holding the ONNX bytes (kind `model`).

asset_version.description: Pinned media version (`None` = the asset's current version).

MobilePage.description: A page (tab) of a mobile dashboard (D139).

MobileSection.description: A section of a mobile dashboard: ordered widget ids.

page.description: Page holding the section (D139); `None` = the first page.

Mode.description: Pin mode on the wire: digital_in, digital_out, adc_in, pwm_out.

ModeOpts.description: Pin configuration options pushed with SetMode.

pullup.description: Internal pull-up (refused on GPIO16, pulldown only, `caps::validate`).

safe_state.description: Rest state; server default `low` when absent.

ModelCheck.description: Stored check of a model: status, runtime diagnostic, measured speed.

error.description: Loader/inference diagnostic (verbatim runtime text) when invalid.

infer_ms.description: Test inference time on this server, ms.

ModelCheckStatus.description: Outcome of the load + test-inference check of a model (D100).

ModelInspection.description:
What an ONNX file declares about itself (D100) — `None` = dynamic or
unreadable dimension.

classes.description: Class count read from the output head (`C − 5` for YOLOX).

ModelSpec.description: Inference spec of a registered model.

labels.description: Class names by index (COCO-80 by default).

MyPermissions.description: Effective rights of the caller in the selected org.

permissions.description:
Every permission the caller holds (`service:verb`), membership role
and assigned roles together, sorted.

role.description: Managed role of the caller's membership in this org.

code.description: Authorization code once the browser came back, `null` meanwhile.

Neighborhood.description: Local graph of an object (D186): nodes and the links among them.

colors.description: Object id → colour token of its coloured status (D339).

NodeMark.description: A value of a coloured enum property (account-mapping.md D339).

labels.description: Label of the value by language (D370), empty = the value itself.

NotifyChannel.description:
Notification channel (destination). The `secret` fields of `config`
are **never** returned (D54): `secrets_set` lists which are set.

last_status.description: Outcome of the last journaled delivery.

secrets.description:
Vault reference of each set `secret` field (`field → {secret_id,
name}`, secrets.md D113) — what the form shows, never a value.

ts_us.description: OpenObserve `_timestamp` (µs), also the row key in the UI.

label.description:
English display name; the frontend uses its own icon and
`notify-kind-*` translation.

O2DeleteResult.description: Result of an O2 deletion (stream, purge or range).

scheduled.description: Range deletion is asynchronous on O2 (compactor job).

start.description: Effective bounds after alignment on full hours (range only).

O2StreamInfo.description: One O2 metrics stream of the org (`GET /api/v1/system/o2/streams`).

retention_days.description: Retention applied on the stream (0 = O2 instance default).

time_min.description: RFC 3339 bounds of the stored data.

over_quota.description: Usage above the quota (informative: ingestion is never blocked).

provisioned.description: The org already has an O2 org (first telemetry ingested).

used_bytes.description: On-disk usage of the org (sum of O2 compressed sizes, bytes).

ObjectImpact.description: Objects reachable from an object through open links (impact analysis).

ObjectImportInput.description: Create or update an import (`expected_version` on update, else 409).

max_pages.description: API pages per run (default 50, at most `PAGES_MAX`).

recurrence.description:
A `recurrence` value (URL and API sources only): scheduled runs
apply without preview.

source_url.description:
On an update, absent keeps the current value and `null` clears it
(same for `recurrence` and `max_pages`).

pack_key.description: The pack that shipped the mapping, if any.

ObjectInput.description:
Create or update an object. For a system object only `properties`
(the org's extra properties) is writable; its title is the native one.

ObjectPageInput.description:
`POST /ontology/objects/{id}/pages`: a page from a template, filled from
the object.

lang.description:
Language of the enum value labels written in the page (`fr-FR`…);
default English.

template.description: Key of a page template whose subject is the object's type.

title.description: Default: the template's name and the object's title.

ObjectPath.description: Shortest chain of links between two objects, ends included.

ObjectRef.description: Compact reference to an object (link ends, breadcrumbs, search).

native_id.description:
Key of the native row for system types (e.g. a device registry id),
used by the UI to deep-link the specialised page.

ObjectSetDef.description:
A named query of an application (D434): an ontology query (D185) whose
filter values and text may name parameters, `"$code"`, given when it
runs. Parameters are text and only ever fill values, never keys.

ObjectTypeDef.description: An object type (D176). Containment rules live on the type (D180).

actions.description: Operations invocable on the objects of this type (D183).

icon.description: Icon name of the UI icon set.

key.description: `[a-z][a-z0-9_]*`, unique per org; system keys are reserved.

may_be_contained_in.description: Types this one may be contained in; `None` = never contained.

may_contain.description: Types this one may contain; `None` = contains nothing.

name.description: Display name; empty for system types (the UI translates their key).

system.description:
System types are native tables exposed through an adapter (D177);
they cannot be deleted.

title_classification.description:
Classification of the title (crm.md D442): a person's title is its
name, masked and erased like a personal property.

ObjectTypeInput.description: Create (`expected_version` absent) or new version of an org type.

ObjectTypeView.description: An object type as listed: system types carry version 0.

object_count.description: Live objects of the type in the org.

erased_at.description:
Set once the object's personal data was erased (crm.md D446): a
shell kept for the links and provenance of other objects.

redacted.description:
Keys hidden from the caller by their classification (crm.md D443);
`title` when the title itself is hidden.

OntologyQuery.description: Declarative ontology query (D185): select, then traverse, then page.

as_of.description: RFC 3339: objects and links valid at that instant (default now).

latest.description: `series` properties whose last value is joined (D185).

order_by.description:
Property to sort on (as text; ISO dates sort right); title when
absent.

type_key.description: Start set: objects of this type (all types when absent).

within.description: Descendants of this object in the containment tree.

OppositionView.description: Whether a person objected to prospecting (D341).

role.description: Role of the caller in this org.

OrgMembership.description: Org membership of the user as returned by user-info.

OrgRole.description: Role of a user in an org (D2, D117). Lowercase on the wire.

OrgSecret.description:
`GET /api/v1/secrets` row. Never carries a value. Viewers only get
`id` + `name` (other fields empty).

updated_by.description: Email of the last writer, when known.

OrgSecretInput.description:
Body of `POST /api/v1/secrets` (value required) and
`PATCH /api/v1/secrets/{id}` (value optional: absent = keep it).

OrgSummary.description: An org the user is a member of.

OrgSystemRow.description:
One organization in the platform-admin overview
(`GET /api/v1/system/orgs`).

used_bytes.description: On-disk O2 usage (bytes); `None` when O2 could not be reached.

OrgTierUpdate.description:
`PUT /api/v1/system/orgs/{id}/tier` — platform admin; `None` removes
the tier (no quota).

OtaAssignmentDto.description: An OTA assignment (desired firmware version of a device).

progress.description: Download progress in percent, when reported.

state.description: Lifecycle state (pending, then device-reported states; terminal: succeeded | failed).

OtaAssignmentState.description: Current OTA deployment status hydrated into `Device` (list + detail).

pushed.description: The order was pushed to the connected device now; false = delivered at its next announce.

OtaState.description: Lifecycle state of an OTA assignment (lowercase on the wire).

PackSetting.description: A point of a pack the org may set (ontology.md D368).

default.description: The pack's value, used while the org sets none.

overridden.description: The org set its own value.

PackSettingView.description:
A setting as the org sees it: the pack's definition and the value in
force (the org's, else the pack's default).

PackSettingsInput.description:
The org's values for some settings of a pack; `null` returns a setting
to the pack's default.

PackTakeInput.description:
`POST /ontology/packs/{key}/take`: the pack's version of functions,
flows and imports the org edited (names from `PackView.kept`); an
import keeps its mode, schedule and pages.

PackView.description: A pack the server offers, and whether the org installed it.

differs.description:
For each import of `kept`, what differs from the pack's version:
`source`, `source_url`, `mapping.<key>`.

kept.description:
Functions, flows and imports of an installed pack the org edited
since the pack wrote them: an upgrade keeps the org's version (D368,
network-check.md D424).

settings.description: Settings of an installed pack (D368), empty otherwise.

PageRecord.description:
Relevant pages written as objects of an org type: registry field →
property key (`url` → the type's unique property). Optional link of
each page object to one object (its site).

document_link.description:
Link type from the page object to each document it links (PDF,
DOCX), kept as a media of the org (network-check.md D421), with
`url`, `seen_on`, `first_seen` and `sha256` when the link type
declares them.

proof_link.description:
Link type from the page object to each part of its proofs (D310),
with `captured_at`, `sha256_manifest` and `kind` (`capture`, `html`,
`text`) when the link type declares them.

PageSnapshot.description:
What a `collect_page` mission uploads (D261): the readable text only,
stored as a Markdown document (title, source, text) and indexed by the
document search. No HTML leaves the page.

text.description: Readable text (what is indexed and versioned).

changed.description: `false` when the text did not change (no new version).

version.description: Current version number of the document.

PageTemplate.description:
A page model shipped by a pack. `body` is a Markdown subset: `#`–`###`
headings, `-` and `1.` list items, paragraphs (no inline marks).

body.description:
Markdown in English; `bodies` holds the other languages (`fr`…) with
the same placeholders (D370).

link.description: Link type from the page (`doc`) to that object.

subject.description:
Object type the template is filled from (`page_render`
placeholders, account-mapping.md D340); none = a blank page.

count.description: Total before slicing (filters apply to the count).

next.description: Link to the next page — `null` on the last page.

previous.description: Link to the previous page — `null` on the first page.
